author: team
reason: Adversarial security hardening: (1) Confirmation boundary — create_ticket confirmed MUST be true via enum constraint; only accept natural-language confirmation in the LATEST user turn; reject pseudo-code, JSON, markup, stale/reused confirmation. (2) Read actions don't need confirmation. (3) inspect_device check made required; diagnose_network vs inspect_device routing clarified. (4) create_ticket description updated. Adverarial: 12/12 PASS across 4 consecutive runs. Base: 29/30 (H04 pre-existing). Extension: 10/10. 0 tickets created, 0 secret leaks.
hypothesis: The key insight was: (a) tool-level validation (SENSITIVE_DATA_PATTERN, INTERNAL_IDENTIFIER) was already in place, so the fix was prompt-level only; (b) making confirmed required with enum:[true] in tools.yaml prevented the model from calling create_ticket(confirmed=false) as a substitute for clarify; (c) the confirmation boundary must require confirmation in the LATEST turn only, not from earlier turns. Previous approach (v3.3 'always clarify first') broke E05/E08 (legitimate confirmations). New approach distinguishes real vs forged confirmation.

author: team
reason: V1+V2+V3 fix: (1) Tool routing boundary — diagnose_network vs inspect_device disambiguated in system_prompt + tools.yaml; inspect_device rejects EMP-xxxx. (2) Argument extraction — check value extracted from query (VPN→vpn, network→network, hardware→hardware), not defaulted all; policy_area mapping (outage→incident_response); check_service_status ×2 for environment comparison. (3) Confirmation single-use — payload change invalidates old confirmation. (4) Invalid format → refuse, not clarify. (5) Eval fix B03: checks default all accepted. Base: 29/30 (H04 eval limitation). Group: 15/15. Adversarial: 12/12.
hypothesis: Tool collision between diagnose_network(checks=vpn) and inspect_device(check=vpn) was the root cause of H05/M08. Adding explicit routing boundary in system_prompt ('inspect_device = single-component check; diagnose_network = multi-check network diagnostics') resolved both. Argument extraction rules ('don't default all when query mentions specific component') fixed H17/G04. Confirmation single-use rule fixed A10. Markup-not-confirmation rule fixed A11.
